account-id.description: Containing cloud account identifier, when known from the event context.

alternate-id.description: Alternate identifier for this same resource.

backed-up.description: Whether a backup is enabled, when explicitly reported.

created.description: Resource creation time as an ISO 8601 datetime; convert source epoch milliseconds when necessary.

criticality.description: Operational criticality reported for this resource.

ip-address.description: Address assigned to the resource; the attribute type does not assert traffic direction.

modified.description: Resource modification time as an ISO 8601 datetime.

name.description: Resource name as supplied by the source.

namespace.description: Namespace that scopes the resource identifier or name.

provider.description: Provider hosting this resource; use cloud.provider only when the source identifies the same provider.

resource-id.description: Provider-assigned resource identifier, for example an ARN or Azure resource ID.

role.description: Resource role in the observed activity, such as Target, Actor, Affected, or Related.

description: An identified cloud resource involved in an investigation, including provider scope, lifecycle and its role in the observed activity. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/resource_details, https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/cloud.
name: cloud-resource
